A beautifully installed pair of closed natural warm oak full-height INTERIOR double doors with fine vertical grain, slim matching oak casing and two elegant slender satin bronze lever handles, in an understated luxury Scandinavian home. Nearly straight-on three-quarter architectural view, exact aligned door leaves, realistic equal reveals and hinges, muted ivory plaster walls, a restrained side opening shows a softly lit room. Door pair centered and broad, occupies central 60% of image width but only central 65% of image height; leave about 17% wall above frame and 18% floor below threshold so the entire door survives a wide horizontal website crop. The oak doors dominate through warm material contrast; minimal peripheral furniture, no decorative plants obscuring edges. Eye-level 35mm perspective, daylight from unseen side window. Premium workmanship and convincing functional doors.
